captions.text: Uniland Motors Group Company Limited. Professional new and used car, and auto parts exporter.
Ten thousand plus units achieved by November twenty twenty five. Over seven years focused on car export. Customers across more than forty countries.
Our development history begins in twenty thirteen, with auto parts export.
In twenty nineteen, Qingdao Uniland Import and Export Company Limited received export qualifications in the first batch issued by the Ministry of Commerce.
In twenty twenty two, the company became an official B Y D distributor in Uzbekistan, investing three million U S dollars in a three thousand square meter store.
In twenty twenty three, Uniland Motors Group was established to support rapid business growth across different regions.
In twenty twenty four, the company obtained new car authorization and established local branch offices and general distributors, including its S R M business vehicle Kazakhstan branch.
By the end of November twenty twenty five, the group had completed shipment of ten thousand units.
Twenty nineteen marked the first electric vehicle export from Khorgos.
In twenty twenty, the company completed its first double deck electric vehicle shipment.
In twenty twenty three, a B Y D four S store in Uzbekistan.
In twenty twenty four, an S R M four S store in Kazakhstan.
In twenty twenty five, more than ten thousand vehicles delivered.
The source presentation highlights twenty twenty six: B Y D’s first overseas fast charging station.
For twenty twenty six to now, the source states an inventory of over one hundred vehicles.
